title: Store Update 1.34.0
body:
# Store Update 1.34.0

Raiders!

Store Update 1.34.0 is going live at this very moment!

This update adds two new items to the store: the Aeronaut Set and the Short Upswept hairstyle. It also patches a fix addressing certain duplication exploit instances.

As always, please report anything unusual you encounter following the update.

See you Topside,

//Ossen
